name: On-call Handoff
description: Opens a handoff form from the issue menu, files it with the team's rota service, and posts the resulting summary on the issue. Demonstrates the modal surface, the manual trigger, and a write-only secret.

rota_name.label: Rota name
rota_name.description: Which rota this workspace hands off. Non-secret: the surface reads it from context.

handoff_window_hours.label: Handoff window (hours)
handoff_window_hours.description: How far back the summary reaches for open incidents.

rota_token.label: Rota service API token
rota_token.description: Write-only. Multica encrypts it and never returns it — not to this form, not to a surface, and not in an http hook body. It is your own credential for your own service; your handler already holds it.

roster_credential.label: Roster MCP server token
roster_credential.description: Write-only. Named <hookKey>_credential for the roster hook, which is the ONLY way Multica ever presents a secret to an endpoint: as the Authorization header on the mcp transport.

hooks.name: File the handoff
hooks.description: Records a handoff with the rota service and returns the summary text to post. Called by the modal via the ui trigger, and available to a person from the issue menu via manual.

notes.description: What the incoming engineer needs to know.

hooks.name: Roster lookups
hooks.description: Tools from the team's roster MCP server: who is on call, and when the next rotation starts.
